# SA1 chair file fixtures

Retrieved 2026-10-29 (Asia/Seoul). SA1 keeps agenda, schedule and TDoc conclusions in one chair file.

- `Agenda for SA1#115_Friday_1550_END_OF_MEETING.docx`:
  https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/Meetings_3GPP_SYNC/SA1/Inbox/agenda/Agenda%20for%20SA1%23115_Friday_1550_END_OF_MEETING.docx
  (last version of SA1#115, Prague, 2026-08-24..28; also in `tsg_sa/WG1_Serv/TSGS1_115_Prague/temp_reports/`).
  Two rooms written inside the cells, Plenary item lists, a lunch-row drafting session with its own time,
  `MMS (18:30-20:00)`, `Meeting ends 16:00`, and the breakout chairs in NOTE paragraphs.
- `Breakout sessions schedule_Prague_WED_1730.docx`:
  https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/Meetings_3GPP_SYNC/SA1/Inbox/agenda/previous_ones/Breakout%20sessions%20schedule_Prague_WED_1730.docx
  (the schedule table alone, uploaded on Wednesday of #115; no title, no agenda; Thursday already planned,
  while the chair file before it still said `Revisions`).
- `Agenda_of_SA1#112_Friday_1610.docx`:
  https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/tsg_sa/WG1_Serv/TSGS1_112_Dallas/report/Agenda_of_SA1%23112_Friday_1610.docx
  (`Drafting 1:`/`Drafting 2:` rooms, the chairs in a one-row table, hand-typed and list-numbered agenda
  headings, `8.8 Verticals` that is not on the agenda, `MMS (18:30)` and VC elections in the lunch row).
- `S1-261408_Agenda_SA1#113_16_00_friday.docx`: from
  https://www.3gpp.org/ftp/tsg_sa/WG1_Serv/TSGS1_113_Goa/report/S1-261408_final_agenda.zip
  (a time column repeated between weekdays, `Last 30 min 8.1.7 Massive+8.1.9 Others`).

Checked before adding: no meeting access information (no Teams link, ID or password) and no personal contact
details. The documents name the SA1 chair as `Contact:` and the session chairs in the NOTE, and mention the
venue's local FTP server address, as every published SA1 agenda does.

`../officials/S1_officialsHistory.htm`: https://www.3gpp.org/DynaReport/TSG-WG--S1--officialsHistory.htm
(main content only), for the chairs' 3GPP spelling.

Tests read these files without network access.
